findings.entity: skater and skateboard during first flip trick
findings.description: After the pop at ~00:01.25 the skater and board stay airborne until ~00:03.25 (~1.8-1.9 s). Between ~00:01.75 and ~00:02.75 both hover at nearly the same height relative to the horizon, with the board slowly rotating under the feet, and nothing visibly holding them up. The camera motion and the approach before the pop look real-time, so this hang time is out of proportion to a normal flat-ground pop (~0.5 s). The effect (time in the air) lags its cause, which reads as floaty, gravity-defying suspension.
